name: L2Beat
source: https://l2beat.com/brand-kit (official brand kit, accessed 2026-10-24: symbol-dark.svg, symbol-light.svg)
notes: Default: the official symbol-dark.svg (the black L2 over the #F9347B heart, for light backgrounds), paths unchanged, placed on the 64 grid
Inverted: the official symbol-light.svg (the white L2 over the #BD114F heart, for dark backgrounds), the same geometry at the same scale and position
Mono: the kit has no one-colour symbol. The heart and the L2 in currentColor, with the L2 cut out of the heart by a 3-unit stroke (mask) so the letters stay readable
